text:
𝗠𝗨𝗟𝗗𝗘𝗥 𝟭𝟬𝟬 + 𝟳/𝟯𝟭! 🔥

Wiaan Mulder's century and 7/31 sank Bangladesh at Centurion.
South Africa won by an innings and 219 runs, sweeping 2-0.

All-round masterclass. 👏
#SAvBAN #Cricket
